config.better_cloud_shadows.title: Better Cloud Shadows
config.better_cloud_shadows.option.cloud: Casts moving shadows on the ground beneath the clouds. Uses Better Clouds' clouds when installed, and vanilla clouds otherwise.
How dark cloud shadows get. They're always lighter near sunrise/sunset and while it's raining.
How far the edges of cloud shadows blur out, in blocks.
How far away cloud shadows are still drawn, in blocks. May be capped by your cloud render distance.
